---
title: "Dimensionality Reduction for EDA"
---

Explore passenger profiles across several variables, then use color and original-variable comparisons to investigate what those profiles mean.

The four methods are PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, and PHATE. Saved coordinates let the examples run immediately after base setup. Recomputing UMAP or PHATE requires the additional packages described on the [notebook page](notebooks.qmd).

## What to investigate

Compare an embedding without color, an input-feature overlay, a missingness overlay, and a withheld outcome overlay. Select a region and return to the original variables. Then ask which interpretation survives a reasonable alternative view.

The [methods guide](methods.qmd) summarizes strengths and limitations. [Run details](run_details.qmd) documents the data, preparation, implementations, and settings.

## Optional tornado practice

Use a fixed 700-record sample from the Day 1 dataset, which covers 4,706 whole tornado tracks from **2015-2018**. Construct profiles from track size and starting location, then overlay EF rating. The exercise is outside the required 50-minute class.
